qualifier: lysophospholipid (S1P/LPA) receptors and phorbol ester/ionophore responses
name: Protein kinase C signaling via lysophospholipid receptors
rationale: Members center on PKC activation by lipid messengers (phorbol ester, ionomycin, PRKCZ, phosphoinositide synthesis, VEGFR2 proliferation), and the S1P/LPA receptor and phorbol/ionophore members distinguish it from the G beta:gamma-PLC, calcium and BCR signaling confusables.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA regulation and glycogen storage diseases
name: Glycogen and glucose metabolism with glucagon-PKA regulation
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown and its storage diseases, glucose-6-phosphate glycolysis/gluconeogenesis and glucagon-PKA control, distinguishing them from confusables focused on fructose, galactose, pentose and hexose absorption.

qualifier: RHO, RND and CDC42 subfamilies with formin activation
name: RHO, RND and CDC42 GTPase cycles and formins
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C/D/F, RND2/3, RHOU/V and CDC42 plus formin activation, distinguished from the RAC/RHOG/WASP-centered and actin-dynamics confusables.

core: Ammonium and carbon dioxide membrane transport
qualifier: Rhesus glycoproteins and erythrocyte gas exchange
name: Rhesus-mediated ammonium and erythrocyte CO2/O2 transport
rationale: Members concern transmembrane movement of ammonium (via Rh glycoproteins) and CO2/O2 exchange in erythrocytes, distinguishing them from bicarbonate-transporter and Rh blood group biosynthesis confusables.

qualifier: neural plate, hindbrain, craniofacial and pharyngeal organs
name: Embryonic neural plate, hindbrain and craniofacial patterning
rationale: Members are early embryonic patterning events (neural plate and border formation, hindbrain rhombomeres, dorsoventral axis, craniofacial, palate, limb and pharyngeal-gland development), distinguished from confusables centered on face/ear sensory organs, somitogenesis and Hox clusters.

qualifier: SREBP sterol and ChREBP glucose sensing
name: SREBP- and ChREBP-driven glucose and sterol-responsive transcription
rationale: Members are transcriptional responses to sugar (ChREBP, carbon catabolite regulation) and sterols (SREBP targets, cholesterol homeostasis), distinguished from the nuclear-receptor (LXR/PPARA), ATF6/CREB3 and glucagon-PKA confusables.

core: Cardiac and striated muscle calcium handling
qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium sequestration, release and Na/Ca exchange
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in heart contraction and relaxation
rationale: Members regulate cytosolic calcium via SR/ER sequestration, ryanodine-receptor release and Na+/Ca2+ exchange to control cardiac (and skeletal) contraction, relaxation and rate, distinguishing them from confusables about plasma-membrane calcium flux, caffeine response and fibre-type switching.

core: Transcriptional control of fatty acid and glucose homeostasis
qualifier: fasting/caloric-restriction gluconeogenesis and PPARA mitochondrial program
name: Nutrient-state transcriptional control of fatty acid and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members link nuclear-receptor-driven gene expression (PPARA, LXR, mitochondrial biogenesis) to fatty acid/triglyceride homeostasis and gluconeogenesis under caloric restriction, distinguished from confusables centered on SREBP/LXR lipogenesis, adipose lipolysis and clock/PGC-1alpha regulation.

qualifier: right ventricle and apoptosis in heart morphogenesis
name: Cardiac ventricle formation and heart morphogenetic apoptosis
rationale: All three members concern forming the (right) ventricle and apoptosis that sculpts the heart, distinguished from confusables on heart field specification, trabecular/compact myocardium, septa and valves.

core: Endosomal receptor recycling to the cell surface
qualifier: postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors under Rab/ARF regulation
name: Rab/ARF-regulated endosomal recycling of postsynaptic receptors
rationale: Members govern endocytic internalization and endosome-to-surface recycling of receptors, notably postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors, regulated by Rab GAPs and ARF signaling, distinguishing them from Golgi-secretory, presynaptic vesicle-cycle and clathrin cargo-recognition confusables.

qualifier: dietary lipid and vitamin E intestinal absorption
name: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance
rationale: Members cover intestinal lipid/sterol/vitamin E absorption and the assembly, remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL, distinguished from confusables centered on cholesterol efflux, HDL biogenesis, LXR regulation and foam cells.

qualifier: ascorbate-dependent and oxidative modification, hyaluronan degradation
name: Ascorbate-linked oxidative ECM maturation and hyaluronan degradation
rationale: Members tie ascorbate/dehydroascorbate supply and oxidative enzyme activity (collagen crosslinking, arylsulfatase activation, protein oxidation) to basement membrane assembly and hyaluronan breakdown, distinguished from confusables on collagen synthesis, integrin/laminin binding and nucleotide-sugar sulfation.

qualifier: gap junction electrical coupling
name: Gap junction electrical coupling in cardiac conduction
rationale: All members concern regulating cardiac conduction through gap junction assembly and electrical cell coupling, distinguishing it from confusables on conduction-system development, calcium handling and action-potential depolarization.

core: Neurovascular barrier and retinal vascular development
qualifier: blood-brain/blood-retinal barrier with FZD4 signaling and retinal pigment epithelium
name: Blood-brain and blood-retinal barrier establishment and retinal vasculature
rationale: Members concern forming the blood-brain and blood-retinal barriers, retinal vessels and RPE, with FZD4 and matrix-cell signaling, distinguished from confusables on lens, cornea and optic-cup eye morphogenesis and placental development.

qualifier: osmotic/salt stress responses and aldosterone-regulated renal sodium transport
name: Osmotic stress responses and aldosterone-regulated renal sodium transport
rationale: Members cover cellular responses to hyper-/hypo-osmotic and salt stress plus renal sodium and chloride transport under aldosterone and renin-angiotensin control, distinguished from potassium-transport and vasopressin/aquaporin water-handling confusables.

qualifier: deadenylation, decapping, 5'-to-3' exonucleolysis and P-bodies
name: mRNA turnover via deadenylation, decapping and P-bodies
rationale: Members regulate general mRNA decay steps (poly(A) shortening, cap removal, 5'-3' exonuclease, P-body assembly) and their counterbalancing stabilization, distinguished from miRNA silencing, polyadenylation and ARE-binding-protein confusables.

core: Mitochondrial adenine nucleotide and NAD transport
qualifier: nicotinate/NAD salvage and virus-induced mitochondrial permeabilization
name: Mitochondrial adenine nucleotide transport, NAD salvage and viral apoptosis
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial ATP/ADP/NAD carriers, nicotinate/NAD salvage and catabolism, and viral (Vpr, influenza) apoptosis via outer-membrane permeabilization, the last being what distinguishes it from nucleotide interconversion, creatine and tryptophan-NAD confusables.

qualifier: repair DNA synthesis, strand annealing and sister chromatid exchange
name: Homologous recombination repair synthesis and sister chromatid exchange
rationale: Members concern DNA synthesis during recombinational double-strand break repair (synthesis-dependent strand annealing, sister chromatid exchange, mitotic recombination), distinguished from confusables on BRCA/Fanconi signaling, checkpoints and telomere recombination.

qualifier: platelet activation, coagulation cascade and fibrinolysis including inherited factor defects
name: Platelet activation, blood coagulation and fibrinolysis
rationale: Members cover platelet adhesion/activation/degranulation, the coagulation cascade and its inherited factor VIII/IX/V/VWF/XII defects, and fibrinolysis control, distinguished from integrin-MAPK, vitamin K carboxylation, eicosanoid and lysophospholipid confusables.

core: Cytochrome P450-dependent sterol and isoprenoid metabolism
qualifier: steroid hormones plus vitamins A, D and K
name: Steroid hormone and fat-soluble vitamin A, D, K metabolism
rationale: Members cover biosynthesis, catabolism and inherited CYP defects of corticosteroids, sex steroids and vitamins A, D and K (including vitamin K-dependent carboxylation), distinguished from thyroid/pituitary hormone, phosphate-mineral and visual retinoid-cycle confusables.

qualifier: PKA and CaMK activation of CREB with MECP2 transcriptional regulation
name: Neuronal cAMP/CaMK-CREB signaling and MECP2 transcriptional regulation
rationale: Members link adenylate cyclase/PKA and CaMK signaling to CREB activation, memory and potentiation, together with MECP2 regulation of neuronal genes, which distinguishes them from NMDA/AMPA receptor and synaptic-plasticity confusables.

qualifier: transcriptional regulation of cadherin genes and EMT restraint
name: Cadherin gene regulation, epithelial identity and EMT restraint
rationale: Members concern transcriptional control of CDH1/CDH11/CDH19, epithelial identity and cadherin adhesion with negative regulation of EMT, distinguished from confusables on cadherin protein trafficking/degradation and adherens-junction assembly.

qualifier: ABCD1 defect in adrenoleukodystrophy
name: Very long-chain fatty acyl-CoA catabolism and adrenoleukodystrophy
rationale: All members concern catabolism of very long-chain fatty acyl-CoAs, whose ABCD1 transport defect causes ALD, distinguished from VLCFA synthesis, generic beta-oxidation and peroxisome import confusables.

qualifier: nuclear lamina depolymerization and envelope reformation
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope and lamina disassembly and reformation
rationale: Members cover mitotic nuclear membrane disassembly, lamina depolymerization, envelope reassembly and protein/pore localization to the envelope, distinguished from ESCRT-III sealing, abscission and nuclear pore complex assembly/transport confusables.

qualifier: pre-rRNA processing and exosome 3'-5' surveillance
name: Pre-rRNA processing and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA surveillance
rationale: Members cover pre-rRNA cleavage, trimming and modification for ribosome assembly plus exosome-mediated 3'-5' decay and surveillance of mRNA, snRNA, snoRNA and tRNA, distinguished from tRNA processing, RNA methylation and Cajal body/telomerase confusables.
